review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Aquatic editor plinth (PROPOSED): the fin and tail editor's reef-stone plinth, a unit-radius slab of layered reef rock with sand settled on its flat top, a stepped, bitten and pitted edge crusted with lilac coral, polyp colonies and two small amber sponges on its rim; replaces the creature editor's pad in the aquatic editor (aquatic plan section 2).

textures.name: T_AquaticPlinth_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

pivot: the centre of the top face (Blender z = 0, Godot y = 0); the slab is 0.35 m deep under it
usage: game/ui/aquatic_editor.gd places it at y = -0.01 and scales it uniformly (PLINTH_SCALE), so the polyps and sponges keep their shape; the camera sees the top face and the far rim against the water.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance per piece; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_aquatic_world.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders (no image sources).
